# Chunk C5: Write tools: action and draft

Paste everything between the two `---` lines into Claude Code, run from your local clone of `ironfis1/cpanel-mail-mcp` with `main` pulled.

---

You are building chunk C5 of cpanel-mail-mcp, a Cloudflare Worker remote MCP server that gives Claude IMAP access to Scott's three cPanel business mailboxes. Read `docs/spec.md` (tag `spec-v1.4`), `docs/build/traceability.md`, `docs/prerequisites.md` and `docs/build/spec-questions.md` before writing code.

## Goal

Implement the write tools: action (pin, unpin, read, unread, archive, move) and draft (new, reply, reply-all, forward, edit, delete) on staging.

## Rules for this chunk (read first)

1. Build to `docs/spec.md` at git tag `spec-v1.4`. Do not edit `docs/spec.md`, `docs/rule-base.md`, `docs/ambiguity-log.md` or `docs/design.md`.
2. Implement only the requirements listed under "In scope". Do not add behavior the spec does not state, even if it seems obviously useful.
3. If a requirement is unclear, contradicts another, or needs a decision the spec does not make: do not decide it. Add an entry to `docs/build/spec-questions.md` (format below), skip that item, finish the rest, and list the question in the PR. Scott resolves it and, if needed, the spec gets a version bump.
4. Every automated test's name starts with the REQ IDs it verifies, for example `REQ-4-7 REQ-4-8: greeting times out after 5 s`.
5. Add `node scripts/trace.mjs --chunk C5 --strict` to the unit job in `.github/workflows/ci.yml`, next to the earlier chunks' lines.
5a. Fill the "Verified by" column of `docs/build/traceability.md` for every in-scope row (test file and test name, or the manual check to perform). Set Status to `built` for automated rows that pass, or `needs Scott` for manual rows.
6. No secrets in the repo, logs, test output or PR. Passwords are entered by Scott with `wrangler secret put` only. Never print a secret value.
7. Work on branch `chunk/C5`. Open a pull request titled `C5: Write tools: action and draft`. Do not merge it. Stop after opening the PR.
8. The PR description contains: in-scope REQs and their status, the exact commands you ran with their pass/fail results, anything deferred and why, and any spec questions raised.

Spec question format (append to `docs/build/spec-questions.md`):

```
## Q<n> (C5)
REQ: <id(s)>
Question: <what is unclear>
Options: <2 or 3 readings>
Blocking: <yes/no; what is skipped until answered>
Resolution:
```

| REQ-1-8 | automated test | There is no send in v1 through any path, including no send through a Spark fallback. |
| REQ-1-11 | automated test | The server shall not permanently delete messages; draft delete is the only delete in scope. |

| REQ-6-37 | automated test | Actions apply per message, not per thread. |

## Deliverables

- `action` with per-ID results, mixed-account calls, archive and move rules, refusals per REQ-18-6 and REQ-18-7.
- `draft` for all six modes per section 9, using the C3 builders and C3 signatures, writing only to Drafts.
- No send path and no permanent delete of received mail anywhere in the code (REQ-1-7, REQ-1-8, REQ-1-11, REQ-3-9).

## Required tests

- Unit tests per mode.
- Edit then edit or delete via the pre-edit ID (REQ-14-12).
- Integration (staging) on both test mailboxes: every draft mode, pin, unpin, archive, move, delete; plus an archive move for the manual Spark check (REQ-14-16).
- A test that greps the built bundle for SMTP or send endpoints and fails if found.

- REQ-14-4 (owned by C0): add the cPanel B MOVE integration test here and append it to the REQ-14-4 "Verified by" cell. After this, set REQ-14-4 Status to `built`.

- From the C2 review: because IDs are not signed, write paths must enforce their own folder rules on the decoded folder, not trust the ID. Delete refuses anything not in Drafts with `\Draft` (REQ-9-26); Trash and Junk are read-only targets except as `move` sources if the spec allows it. Add a test that a hand-built ID pointing at Inbox cannot be deleted. REQ-2-7 is partial after C2: add the draft-mode tests on both YCD accounts to its "Verified by" cell and set it to `built`.

- From the C3 review: REQ-18-8 is partial after C3 (quote format blocked on Q4). Build the quote formatter to match the Spark samples in `docs/build/samples/` per Q4's resolution, add tests against them, append them to the REQ-18-8 "Verified by" cell and set it to `built`. Also settle per Q5's resolution whether an edit that "replaces the body whole" (REQ-9-25) keeps the quoted original; if Q5 does not settle it, raise a spec question.
